body:
**Summary**

This PR fixes a discrepancy between JS and React implementations of the Autocomplete widget. In JS, it now triggers an initial search request with the `query` from the target index.

I also moved the default `hitsPerPage` to the configure of the actual index, the initial refine solving the issue that prompted to set `hitsPerPage` to a higher level.

FX-3571
